title: Proposals
description: Hypotheses, predicate claims and trial requests proposed by Relentra (pipeline step 7, AI on only), or submitted externally through the MCP verify_hypothesis tool (mode external). Proposals never decide: FaultLoom's claim pass re-evaluates every claim for every claim-pass pool candidate, and Causentra reads the result (03 §9.1).

status.description: complete: the state machine reached done; budget_exhausted: a budget stopped it (finished proposals kept); failed: provider error or no valid output after repair; skipped: AI on but the model was not called (relentra.enabled false or empty slate).

mode.description: brief (default) or investigate, from config; external only for hypotheses submitted through the MCP verify_hypothesis tool, never written by Relentra.

model.description: Model and sampler parameters actually sent; null for mode external and for status skipped (contract_changes B).

proposals.description: Normalised proposals (08 §3.6), sorted by (hypothesis.service, hypothesis.fault_class, proposal_id). May be empty.

asks.description: Requests for more information from the model, sorted by (kind, target); at most 3 (08 §3.4).

allOf.description: mode external: hypotheses were submitted through MCP and no model was called, so model is null (03 §9.1).
status skipped: the model was not called, so model is null (03 §9.1).

ProposalsModel.title: ProposalsModel
ProposalsModel.description: LLM provider, model identity and sampler parameters of the run (config/llm.yaml, config/relentra.yaml).

name.description: Model name or tag as configured (model.name), e.g. qwen3.5:9b.

gguf_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the pinned GGUF weights file (model.gguf_sha256); null when not pinned.

SamplerParams.title: SamplerParams
SamplerParams.description: Sampler parameters actually sent to the provider.

BudgetUsed.title: BudgetUsed
BudgetUsed.description: Budget consumed. turns counts LLM calls including repairs; tokens are provider-reported usage stored in the cassette; wall_ms is the sum of recorded call latencies, so a replay reproduces it.

Proposal.title: Proposal
Proposal.description: One hypothesis with the predicate claims and trials that would test it. proposal_id = P + first 8 hex of SHA-256(canonical_json({hypothesis, claims without claim_id})).

claims.description: Claims sorted by (predicate, canonical_json(args)); claim ids are assigned in this order.

requested_trials.description: Trials the proposer asks Causentra to run, unique, at most 4, in ascending trial number (T1 < T2 < ... < T10, the trial_id enum order, not byte order). Causentra decides which trials run.

rationale.description: Display only; never read by code. At most 280 code points.

Hypothesis.title: Hypothesis
Hypothesis.description: Proposed root cause. service must be a graph.nodes.node (checked by Causentra as unknown_entity, not by this schema).

Claim.title: Claim
Claim.description: A library predicate the proposer wants checked. The subject is implied (hypothesis.service for T10; every claim-pass pool candidate in FaultLoom's claim pass).

claim_id.description: <proposal_id>-<i>, i from 1 in sorted claim order; the prefix equals the parent proposal_id (writer check).

args.description: Predicate arguments after the subject, keyed by parameter name. Permissive in the schema: a subject key, unknown names and out-of-range values are rejected per claim as bad_args by FaultLoom and Causentra, not here.

additionalProperties.description: A scalar argument value. integer is listed next to number (same JSON values) so generated models keep an int parameter such as min_count an integer, and canonical_json (proposal_id) does not change on a model round-trip.

cites.description: Atom ids (E + 10 hex) or tool-call ids (tc:<seq>, investigate mode), 0-3 per claim. For display and audit only; the decision uses only the claim-pass result.

ProposalAsk.title: ProposalAsk
ProposalAsk.description: A request for more telemetry, a trial or context.
